name: WordPress
description: Open source publishing software that powers a large share of the web.
summary: WordPress permits AI-assisted code, tests, documentation, and issue drafts, but contributors must disclose meaningful AI use, review and test all output, stay accountable, and ensure GPL-compatible licensing. Large unreviewed “AI slop” and license-incompatible output may be rejected.

evidence.quote: Yes, provided:
The tool’s terms allow GPL-compatible licensing of the output.
You disclose meaningful AI assistance.
You review, understand, and test all contributions.
If you leveraged AI in a meaningful way, please disclose it. For trivial assistance (for example, AI suggests a variable name or reorders imports), disclosure is optional.
Treat AI output like code from an unknown external contributor: you must review and validate it before sharing it.
Once submitted, code contributed by you, regardless of whether it was typed or AI-generated, is considered your code and therefore your responsibility.
You must understand what the code does and why.
You must be able to explain the approach during review.
Do not use tools whose terms forbid using their output in GPL-licensed projects or impose additional restrictions on redistribution.
